title: CISA Warns Fortinet Customers as FortiBleed Hits 86,644 FortiGate Devices
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Thursday urged Fortinet customers with FortiGate appliances to take steps to secure against ongoing malicious activity aimed at thousands of internet-accessible devices.

title: From Assistive to Agentic: The AI Shift That's Redefining Threat Management

sections.overview:
Introduction

The average enterprise security team has 40 or more security tools, giving a lot of visibility into internal telemetry and asset data. But often, these tools are working in siloes, generating (overlapping) alerts and data.

title: Forget Data Leakage: Shadow AI's Real Threat Is Access Control
